activity_validation_debt.unknown: Actual Hungarian fuel composition/calorimetry, measured annual heating activity, source-model target transfer and national allocation are not established; 0.92 is a source convention.

factor_validation_debt.unknown: No case-specific or Hungarian measured carbon-per-energy, actual oxidation/stack-species reconciliation or calibrated population emission distribution is established.
factor_validation_debt.upgrade: Compatible fuel/carbon/NCV evidence or an accepted claim-matched inventory-method calibration; no requirement for exhaustive household microdata.

shared_factor_comparison: One common factor parameter multiplies the signed difference of two source-case NCV activities. No independent endpoint subtraction or Cartesian factor cases.

admission_criteria.quantity: Annual direct-combustion inventory-method CO2 mass for three named heating-only source gas cases.
admission_criteria.boundary: kgCO2 from TJ NCV fuel input; static historical TABULA variants, not current measured households.
admission_criteria.authority: IPCC2006 Volume2 Chapter2 Table2.5; preserved original and official2019 refinement context.
admission_criteria.applicability: Original workbook explicitly maps Gas to natural gas,type unknown. Existing V1-045 consumer supplies compatible source-convention NCV activity.
admission_criteria.contradiction: The scoped generic method does not replace country-specific factors or measured gas evidence; stronger target-specific evidence must supersede this default if that target is claimed.
admission_criteria.debt: Activity and factor applicability remain separately explicit; source-factor limits do not bound either full debt.
admission_criteria.label: Official method factor ASS; conditional calculated output DER/E2, never observed Hungarian emissions.

exclusions: No actual measured stack emission or Hungarian household/population factor
No net climate saving or causal realised renovation saving
No CH4/N2O/GWP/CO2e, lifecycle, fuel-upstream or refrigerant calculation
No exposure, health, valuation, readiness uplift or whole-slice acceptance
No old full B17 factor-panel recovery claim
No original PDF or complete factor-table redistribution
